proof: Each consumed ingredient deducts its captured default crafting remainder; retained catalysts consume zero. Each purchase has cost>=potential; each expected recipe output sum<=minimum input sum for every alternative; each maximum-demand sell payout<=potential. Therefore any finite composition of modeled conversions has non-positive expected monetary gain, including coproducts. Funds/quotas/replay are separate runtime gates.
limits: ACTIVE_USER_ALLOWED_AUTOMATION_EXEMPTION: copper ingot to raw copper mincer remains active with positive byproduct buyback; no no-arbitrage claim covers compositions using that productive circuit.
Expected probabilities, not a guarantee every lucky finite craft loses money.
Only current captured and explicitly modeled recipes; dynamic/NBT/progression and unproven native container remainder handlers remain explicitly excluded.
Default crafting remainders are conservatively returned; GenericItemEmptying exact native caller returns only the explicit single output, with no extra remainder.
